messages:
maya: FYI — saw initial-context cold-hit rate drop ~12pp on canary after today's matmul-vectorize kernel flip + awq-8 quant profile. Affects mistral-7b and llama2-13b traffic.
jon: Can you share traces / quick numbers?
li: attaching quick flame snapshots, short summary: matmul vector kernel time went up slightly (expected), but more importantly warmup hit-rate for 1-3 token prefixes dropped a bunch. KV lookup time itself looks same.
li: ```
flame: matmul_vec_kernel 42%
attn_kernel 28%
kv_lookup 5%
```
ravi: infra shows rollout toggled `vectorize_matmul=true` and `continuous_batching_ms` changed from 8 -> 3 on canary to hit P99 latency SLOs.
maya: ah — we shrank batching window to reduce latency; that also reduced batch accumulation for priming traffic so fewer requests see a warmed KV cache. That explains hit-rate drop.
jon: hmm — could kernel tag changes also affect cache keys?
li: yes. keygen is (model_id, tokenizer_hash, prefix_hash, kernel_variant_tag). The vectorize rollout flips kernel_variant_tag from `matmul_v1` -> `matmul_vec_v2`. I think key salting ordering changed (old code salted prefix hash after kernel tag; new fastpath salts before). Means previously-warmed entries don't match.
ravi: infra-bot: rollout metadata for canary: {canary_pool: 2 hosts, deploy_id: deploy-20260318-vec, continuous_batching_ms: 3, quant_profile: awq-8, kernel_tag: matmul_vec_v2}.
jon: if both batching and key-tag changed we get compounded regression — fewer opportunities to warm + mismatch for existing warm entries.
maya: Proposal: 1) quick lookup compatibility layer: on lookup, accept legacy kernel tags (map `matmul_vec_v2` -> `matmul_v1` alias) for prefix-key resolution; 2) revert batching window to 8ms on canary while we validate vectorized path; 3) add unit tests for stable kernel_tag hashing.
li: I can prototype the alias patch; small change in keygen lookup (try full key, then legacy-tag variant). Should be cheap and safe.
jon: Also add an alert in perf monitoring: prefix-warm-hit-rate delta >5pp over 5m for any model-route.
ravi: infra-bot: scheduling rollback — initiating canary rollback now.
infra-bot: rollback started for deploy-20260318-vec on canary pool.
infra-bot: rollback completed on canary hosts [canary-01, canary-02] at 2026-03-18T16:12Z.
li: Post-rollback sample: cold-hit returned to baseline, warm-hit +11pp on the sample window.
maya: follow-ups: li to open PR for compatibility fallback; jon to add alert + dashboard widget for prefix-hit deltas; ravi to gate batching window change behind an A/B run.
jon: I'll open the alert PR and a short runbook for ops.
maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
